task_text: Turn on coffee machine and TV

central_instructions.R1: Check if the coffee machine is accessible and press the power button to turn it on.
central_instructions.R2: Ensure the TV remote is within reach and press the power button to turn on the TV.
central_instructions.R3: Assist R1 by ensuring the coffee machine is plugged in and ready to be turned on.
central_instructions.R4: Assist R2 by locating the TV remote and ensuring it is within R2's reach.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Move to the coffee machine. (r1_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Press the power button on the coffee machine to turn it on. (r1_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Move to the TV location. (r1_s3)

[15-20 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Press the power button on the TV to turn it on. (r1_s4)
agent_plans.R2:
[0-5 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Locate the TV remote on the coffee table. (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Press the power button on the TV remote to turn on the TV. (r2_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Move to the coffee machine area. (r2_s3)

[15-20 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Press the power button on the coffee machine to turn it on. (r2_s4)
agent_plans.R3:
[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Move to the coffee machine to check if it is plugged in. (r3_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] Move to the coffee machine to assist R3. (r1_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [HELP] Confirm the coffee machine is plugged in and ready to be turned on. (r3_s2)
- R1 [LOCAL] Turn on the coffee machine. (r1_s2)
- R3 [LOCAL] Move to the TV to prepare for turning it on. (r3_s3)
- R1 [LOCAL] Move to assist R3 with the TV. (r1_s3)

[10-15 min]
- R3 [HELP] Ensure the TV is plugged in and ready to be turned on. (r3_s4)
- R1 [LOCAL] Turn on the TV. (r1_s4)
agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Locate the TV remote in the living room. (r4_s1)
- R2 [LOCAL] Move to the vicinity of the TV. (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [PASS] Place the TV remote within R2's reach. (r4_s2)
- R2 [LOCAL] Turn on the TV using the remote. (r2_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Move to the coffee machine. (r4_s3)
- R4 [LOCAL] Turn on the coffee machine. (r4_s4)
